title: Adaptive Federated Q-Learning with Importance Averaging: Near-Optimal Sample Complexity and K-Independent Communication

contributions.purpose: 给出对异质行为策略鲁棒的联邦 Q-learning 算法
contributions.mechanism: 局部异步 Q-learning + 同步时按访问计数做 importance averaging(权重 ω∝N_k)+ doubling 通信调度
contributions.evaluation: 每 stage 通信一次;未访问 (s,a) 回退上一轮全局值
contributions.domain: 联邦强化学习/表格 Q-learning 理论
contributions.source_quote: local asynchronous Q-learning with importance averaging at synchronization and an adaptive doubling communication schedule

contributions.purpose: 确定正确覆盖度量并达近最优样本复杂度
contributions.mechanism: stage-wise 分析:访问计数集中 + importance averaging 偏差衰减 + Freedman 鞅噪声控制
contributions.evaluation: 按总环境步数达 Õ(1/(µavg(1-γ)^5 ε²)) 匹配集中式(up to logs);覆盖度量为平均平稳占用最小项 µavg 而非最差 agent µmin
contributions.source_quote: the sample complexity matches a centralized learner up to logarithmic factors and depends on the minimum entry of the average stationary occupancy, not the worst single agent

contributions.purpose: 给出与 K 无关的通信复杂度
contributions.mechanism: doubling schedule 下偏差项几何收缩,同步轮数不随 agent 数 K 增长
contributions.evaluation: 同步轮数 Õ((1-γ)^-1 log(1/ε)),independent of K
contributions.source_quote: The number of synchronization rounds is Õ((1−γ)^{-1} log(1/ε)), independent of K.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Building on the heterogeneity insight of [28], we show that importance averaging robustifies federated Q-learning against disparate local policies while preserving linear speedup and K-independent communication.

Our paper sharpens and simplifies this picture by (i) clarifying the time scale (total steps across agents), (ii) making the µavg dependence explicit ... and (iii) proving that a doubling schedule yields K-independent synchronization complexity
